hard_gates: Predicted and actual may never share the same dash/marker topology, even when one track is selected or dimmed.
Legend swatches must use the exact resolved stroke, dash, tick and endpoint topology used on the table.
Track visibility and identity must remain understandable in monochrome; a grayscale structure classifier must detect dashed+ring versus solid+ticks without reading RGB.
Every visible stroke must maintain local contrast >=3.0:1 against the rendered background; use a 1 px logical dark halo where the raw color cannot meet this on felt, rail, ball or walnut.
No trajectory style may imitate the shipping aim guide; predicted and actual require their legend text whenever either track is visible.

world_cm_to_presentation_projection_and_.source_units: world centimeters from PreviewSample.cueBallPosition and replay::TrajectorySample.position
world_cm_to_presentation_projection_and_.visual_anchor: Use authoritative sample x/z without smoothing or physics-space edits. Render the path on y=play_surface_y_cm+0.15 cm to read as a cloth route; retain the unmodified full Point3 in evidence diagnostics.
world_cm_to_presentation_projection_and_.camera_source: The exact CameraPresentation used for the scene frame, including eye, target, fieldOfViewDegrees, projectionPan, preset, transition state and physical viewport.

matrix_contract.projection: Renderer-shared OpenGL perspective(clamp(FOV,25,75) degrees, physical_width/physical_height, near=2.0 cm, far=1800.0 cm)
matrix_contract.clip_equation: clip=P*V*vec4(world_cm,1); never use the legacy flat project(x,z) approximation
matrix_contract.valid_homogeneous_segment: Both finite, with line segment clipped against -w<=x<=w, -w<=y<=w, -w<=z<=w and w>1e-5 before perspective divide

clip_rules: Clip each world segment homogeneously before perspective divide; reject NaN/Inf and non-increasing tick transitions.
After viewport mapping, clip to the intersection of the physical framebuffer, gameplay safe area and projected play-surface stencil; expand the exclusion by half the resolved stroke width.
Break the polyline when cueBallVisible is false, the replay trajectory resets, a tick decreases, or the projected segment crosses an invalid homogeneous region.
Do not clamp an offscreen endpoint to an edge and do not draw a false endpoint marker. Show Endpoint offscreen in the legend/detail row instead.
Dash phase and actual tick arc-length accumulation continue across source sample boundaries but restart after a real clipped/visibility break; dash phase may not restart every segment.
Predicted and actual screen polylines may be visually simplified only after projection, using maximum perpendicular error <=0.35 physical px; source samples and counts remain unchanged.
The shared renderer projection and overlay projection must agree within 0.5 physical px at every finite sample and all four camera presets.

endpoint_and_rail_authority.predicted_endpoint: PreviewResult final visible cue sample through OverlayTrack.endpoint; never inferred from drawn pixels.
endpoint_and_rail_authority.actual_endpoint: ReplayTransportSnapshot.cueEndpoint when cueEndpointVisible; never inferred from drawn pixels.
endpoint_and_rail_authority.rail_count: Use OverlayTrack.railCollisionEvents supplied by preview/replay event telemetry; never count polyline turns.
endpoint_and_rail_authority.display_precision: Endpoint X/Z in cm rounded to 0.1 cm; rail count as an exact nonnegative integer.
endpoint_and_rail_authority.machine_gate: Displayed endpoint/count strings and marker visibility must equal the bound TrajectoryOverlaySnapshot fields exactly.

physical_pixel_style_ranges.interpretation: All ranges are inclusive physical framebuffer pixels after device density and UI scale resolution. Stroke and marker edges must be pixel-snapped; values outside the range are hard failures.

pattern_sampling_rules.dash_space: screen-space arc length after projection and clipping
pattern_sampling_rules.tick_orientation: perpendicular to the central-difference screen-space tangent; endpoint uses one-sided tangent
pattern_sampling_rules.short_track_rule: If a predicted track is shorter than three full dash cycles, resolve to exactly three equal dash/gap pairs while retaining the endpoint ring; never silently render it solid.

safe_area_contract.machine_gate: All panel, text, icon and focus bounds lie inside the resolved safe area; overlap_pairs and truncated_text_runs equal zero.

hierarchy_order: scenario title plus terminal score or Attempt active
success/failure reason plus explicit Replay ready/Replay unavailable status
Predicted and Replay actual legend rows with endpoint X/Z and rail count
Preview trajectory, Retry shot, Save replay and playback controls

text_size_contract.formula: minimum rendered physical px = max(14*device_scale, base_logical_px*ui_scale*device_scale)

legend.hidden_track_behavior: Keep its row visible with Hidden text and unchanged style swatch; do not erase identity or recolor it as disabled-only gray.

result_and_replay_state.success: Show Succeeded, numeric Score 0..100 and Replay ready when the controller reports replayReady.
result_and_replay_state.failure: Show Failed plus the exact non-empty evaluation.reason; color and icon may reinforce but text is mandatory.
result_and_replay_state.active: Show Attempt active plus exact shot count; score is not shown as final.
result_and_replay_state.replay_unavailable: Show Replay unavailable and reason Available after terminal success or failure; Save replay is visibly disabled using text+icon+shape, not alpha alone.

retry_training.label: Retry shot
retry_training.state_detail: Pre-shot state / Fresh recorder and attempt facts

save_training_replay.label: Save replay
save_training_replay.state_detail: Replay v1 / Choose a local destination

expanded_behavior.activation: explicit pointer or keyboard action only
visible_fields: trace/content hashes abbreviated with full accessible value
expanded_behavior.layout: Reflow below the legend; at 1280x720 ui135 use a one-column bounded detail drawer and preserve the footer rather than clipping or hiding controls.

machine_gates: A fresh TrajectoryOverlayModel snapshot has advancedExpanded=false.
Collapsed captures contain zero advanced field text runs and zero advanced field geometry.
Expanded captures require one focusable close/toggle action and no safe-area, overlap or truncation failures.

core_minimum.common_state: comparison_ready: hash-bound predicted preview plus hash-bound ReplayTransport actual, both endpoints/counts visible where in-frame, terminal result/replay-ready controls visible, advanced collapsed
core_minimum.fixture_rule: Predicted must come from PreviewResult and actual from a validated Replay v1 loaded by ReplayTransportModel. Placeholder, hand-authored or copied screen paths are forbidden.

representative_extension.outcome_coverage: Across the five representatives, bind at least two terminal success and two terminal failure fixtures; every failure has non-empty reason text and every terminal fixture exposes replay-ready/save state.

capture_binding: Each capture ID uniquely binds scenario ID+SHA, state, camera preset, viewport, device scale, palette, UI scale, build/executable/asset/profile hashes and PNG SHA.
All captures use GPU framebuffer readback from the production renderer; desktop screenshots and flat proofs are inadmissible.
Missing, duplicate, selector-drifted or non-hash-bound captures fail the complete matrix.

visual_and_layout: Predicted semantic color plus dashed line plus endpoint ring exactly match this contract.
Actual semantic color plus solid line plus perpendicular ticks/tick-dot exactly match this contract.
All resolved physical sizes are inside the profile/UI-scale ranges.
Projection agreement maximum error <=0.5 physical px and every segment passes homogeneous/safe/playfield clipping.
Endpoint marker visibility, endpoint X/Z strings and rail counts exactly equal TrajectoryOverlaySnapshot.
Legend, result, reason, replay-ready and controls satisfy hierarchy, minimum text, contrast and safe-area contracts.
safe_area_violations=0, truncated_text_runs=0, overlap_pairs=0, debug_node_count=0, opaque_icon_count=0 and unexpanded_icon_count=0.
Advanced defaults collapsed; explicit expanded extension obeys reflow and close-action gates.
machine_acceptance_gates.fail_closed: Any machine gate failure blocks TA review and no evidence PASS or M3 claim may be emitted.

preview_before_equals_after.existing_minimum: TrainingProductController already compares game-state hash, tick and event count; implementation evidence must extend the attestation to all fields above.

overlay_render_before_equals_after.rule: Building, projecting, clipping, drawing, toggling track visibility or expanding Advanced details may mutate only UI/overlay presentation state. It may not call GameRuntime step/action APIs or change replay fixed-step state.
overlay_render_before_equals_after.replay_transport_exception: Only an explicit replay transport control may change isolated ReplayTransportModel tick/paused/rate/camera state; it still may not change authoritative GameRuntime.

authority_and_simulation_immutability.evidence_gate: Record canonical before/after hashes around both preview generation and at least 300 overlay-render frames for every core capture fixture; any mismatch is a hard FAIL.

external_real_human_12_record_boundary.exact_scenario_coverage: One complete record for every scenario_contract ID on one frozen build/assets/executable/physics profile.
replay_checks: same Replay v1 file replays twice to the declared final-state hash
external_real_human_12_record_boundary.automation_boundary: Automation artifacts must be attached but cannot substitute for real manual play, open response, executor/observer attestations or PII review.
external_real_human_12_record_boundary.design_and_gpu_boundary: This design gate, machine matrix and TA visual review cannot populate or imply any of the 12 external-human records. Until all 12 validator-complete records PASS, external-human acceptance remains NOT_RUN.

promotion_state_machine.condition: Implementation exists but any machine gate or matrix binding fails
All >=68 actual-GPU captures and machine gates pass
Independent TA reviews all bound PNGs and any axis fails
Machine and TA pass but external real-human records are incomplete
Machine, TA and all 12 external-human validator records pass on one frozen candidate

design_conclusion: The overlay implementation must preserve the existing TrajectoryOverlayModel semantics while adding a shared-camera, homogeneous-clipped GPU renderer and a shipping hierarchy that remains readable without color. This artifact authorizes implementation only; no GPU capture, TA approval, external-human result, M3 acceptance or golden status is claimed.
